Official FAQ

Temptation Token $TTS — FAQ

Updated May 2026 · Base Blockchain · Everything you need to know

What is Temptation Token? +

Temptation Token ($TTS) is the first vote-to-earn cryptocurrency game on Base blockchain — Coinbase's Ethereum Layer 2. Launched April 2026.

Each week, approved profiles compete in a voting round. Players spend $TTS tokens to vote on profiles. At round close, Chainlink VRF selects the winner — weighted by votes, so more votes means better odds. Prizes are automatically paid by the smart contract with zero human involvement.

Play now at app.temptationtoken.io

How does voting work? What are the prize splits? +

Connect your wallet at app.temptationtoken.io, hold $TTS, and vote a minimum of 5 $TTS on any approved profile. Votes are final and non-refundable.

When the round ends (Sunday 11:59 PM EDT), the smart contract automatically splits the prize pool:

RecipientShareDetails
🏆 Top Voter35%Wallet that voted most $TTS on winning profile
📸 Winning Profile35%Profile's registered wallet
💙 Polaris Project10%Anti-trafficking charity — hardcoded
🏢 Blockchain Entertainment LLC20%House cut (operations)

With a club partner: When a winning profile was submitted via a club referral code, the 20% house share splits — 10% to the club, 10% to the house. All other splits remain the same.

What blockchain is $TTS on? Is it still on Polygon? +

Temptation Token is on Base mainnet (Chain ID: 8453) — Coinbase's Ethereum Layer 2. It is not on Polygon. Any previous references to Polygon are outdated and should be disregarded.

Base offers fees typically under $0.01 per transaction with Ethereum-level security. You need ETH on Base for gas, and $TTS on Base to play.

How do I buy $TTS on Base? +

$TTS trades on Uniswap V2 on Base. Step by step:

  1. Install MetaMask or use Coinbase Wallet
  2. Add Base network (Chain ID: 8453, RPC: mainnet.base.org)
  3. Bridge ETH to Base via bridge.base.org
  4. Go to app.uniswap.org on Base network
  5. Paste the contract: 0x5570eA97d53A53170e973894A9Fa7feb5785d3b9
  6. Set slippage to 2%+ (1% transfer tax requires this)
  7. Swap ETH → $TTS

Important: Only buy from the official contract above. Always verify on BaseScan. There are copycat tokens.

How do I submit a profile to compete? +
  1. Connect your wallet at app.temptationtoken.io
  2. Go to the Submit tab
  3. Upload a photo and enter your display name
  4. Pay the 5 $TTS submission fee
  5. Admin reviews your submission (SFW content only — typically same day)
  6. Once approved, you appear in the current or next round

Requirements: Safe for work photos only. No nudity, no explicit content, no minors. Submission fees are non-refundable whether approved or rejected.

What is staking? What APR can I earn? +

Stake $TTS to earn weekly yield and multiply your voting power. Five tiers based on USD value staked (calculated live from the Uniswap price):

TierMin Stake (USD)APRVote Multiplier
🥉 Bronze$50+8%1.1x
🥈 Silver$100+12%1.25x
🥇 Gold$250+18%1.5x
💎 Diamond$1,000+32%2x
👑 VIP$5,000+45%3x

Multipliers are hardcoded in the smart contract and cannot be changed. A VIP staker's 1,000 $TTS vote counts as 3,000 $TTS toward their odds of being the top voter.

Is the game provably fair? Can the team rig it? +

Yes — winner selection is provably fair via Chainlink VRF V2.5 on Base. When a round closes, the contract requests a verifiable random number from Chainlink's decentralized oracle network. The proof is published on-chain — verifiable by anyone.

Not even the developers can predict or manipulate the outcome. The algorithm is immutable in the audited contract.

VRF Subscription ID: 58222014...63722 — verifiable at vrf.chain.link/base

Has the smart contract been audited? +

Yes. Audited by Solidproof — a professional blockchain security firm based in Germany (April 2026).

✓ Zero Critical Findings ✓ Zero High Findings

Three medium-severity findings were identified and acknowledged — fixes are queued for the next contract upgrade. TrustNet Score: 17.92.

📄 Full report: app.solidproof.io/projects/temptation-token

What is the Polaris Project? Why does 10% go to charity? +

Polaris Project is a US nonprofit that operates the National Human Trafficking Hotline and provides survivor support.

Temptation Token donates 10% of every single prize pool to Polaris. This is hardcoded in the smart contract — it cannot be turned off, redirected, or skipped under any circumstances. Every round. Automatic. Verifiable on BaseScan.

Polaris wallet: 0xf7dd429d679cb61231e73785fd1737e60138aba3

How does the club referral program work? +

Clubs, agencies, and creator networks can register as partners. When a club-referred profile wins, the prize split adjusts:

RecipientStandardWith Club
Top Voter35%35%
Winning Profile35%35%
Polaris Project10%10%
Club Partner—10%
Blockchain Entertainment LLC20%10%

The club's 10% is paid automatically on-chain — no invoice, no request. To register: support@temptationtoken.io

When do rounds start and end? +

Rounds run Monday 12:00 AM EDT → Sunday 11:59 PM EDT — exactly one week. Settlement via Chainlink VRF happens automatically within minutes of round close. A new round begins immediately after.

Note: The schedule is EDT (UTC−4). During winter (November–March), clocks shift to EST (UTC−5), causing a 1-hour drift due to Chainlink's UTC-only cron system.

Is there a transfer tax on $TTS? +

Yes. $TTS has a 1% transfer tax on all buys, sells, and transfers. This is hardcoded and cannot be increased or removed by anyone — including the team.

When buying on Uniswap, set slippage to 2%+ to account for this tax.

Ready to Play?

Connect your wallet and start voting in under 60 seconds. New users get a free $TTS welcome bonus.

Play Now — app.temptationtoken.io Join Telegram Community
